title: Cruise speed is now indicated airspeed (IAS)
body:
The cruise **Speed** field on your aircraft and flight-default profiles is now labelled **Cruise Speed (IAS in kt)** and read as **indicated airspeed**. For time and distance estimates we convert it to **true airspeed (TAS)** at your selected cruise altitude using the ISA standard atmosphere — TAS is higher than IAS aloft (roughly +2% per 1,000 ft), so estimates now respond when you change altitude.

Because existing stored speeds are reinterpreted as IAS, **auto-calculated durations get a little shorter** at typical cruise altitudes (~13% shorter at 8,000 ft). Manually entered durations are untouched. Tap the new (i) button next to the speed field for the details.
